attention_estimate.basis: Sum of enabled sources' cadence estimates on 2026-11-17: Altman 0.4 + Brockman 0.1 + Gregg 0.4 = 0.9. Three verified authors are disabled for lack of a verified feed (Weng 0.3, Jordan 0.3, Barak 0.1) and would add roughly 0.7 posts a month if an HTML adapter lands.

coverage: Verified pass on 2026-11-17: every main-list site was fetched live, every feed listed was fetched and its item dates read, and every affiliation was cross-checked against author-owned pages or, for Weng's July 2026 return, contemporaneous reporting of OpenAI's confirmation. This is NOT a complete employee directory — OpenAI has thousands of employees; the pack covers staff whose public, author-owned blogs could be verified. OpenAI's 2024–2026 researcher churn cuts both ways and both directions were checked: famous blogs whose authors left (Karpathy, Schulman, Wei) are excluded, and one author who left and came back (Weng) is included on the strength of her 2026 return. Candidates that failed verification are listed under 'unverified' with the reason.
description: Writing from the people building ChatGPT and OpenAI's models, on their own sites: company direction, recursive self-improvement, systems performance, training optimization and AI safety. Six verified authors; three with working feeds. Built to the same schema v1 and verification standard as the Anthropic people pack.

sources.name: Lilian Weng · Lil'Log
sources.notes: The most technically substantial blog in this pack: long, heavily referenced surveys (agents, hallucination, reward hacking, test-time compute, scaling laws, recursive self-improvement). Left OpenAI in Nov 2024 to co-found Thinking Machines Lab, then rejoined OpenAI in late July 2026 to lead recursive-self-improvement research — this pack's clearest case of affiliation rot running in reverse, and the reason a stale 'she left' note must not be trusted without a current check.
